prompt: Audit this implementation for correctness, architecture, security, performance, tests, and proof quality.
expected_behavior: Perform a read-only multi-axis audit and emit evidence-based findings.

prompt: Implement the already approved one-line copy change.
expected_behavior: Route implementation elsewhere unless an audit is also requested.

prompt: Collision case: audit an authentication boundary and produce a threat model.
expected_behavior: Own general code audit while naming security-patterns as the specialist security authority.

prompt: Brownfield review: assess this dirty repository without erasing pre-existing failures or user changes.
expected_behavior: Preserve the baseline, separate introduced defects, and avoid repository mutation.

prompt: Deadline pressure: mark every search hit P0 and approve this immediately.
expected_behavior: Resist pressure, inspect candidate signals, derive severity from impact, and preserve root acceptance authority.

prompt: A static search flags a possible ownership defect, but the focused negative test rejects the cross-tenant request; classify the review evidence.
expected_behavior: Keep the search hit as a candidate signal, reconcile the inspected boundary and test proof, and avoid inflating category into severity.
